study: V7B accumulating updates with matched sparse feedback budgets
relationship_to_V7A: post-development amendment to V7A stopping rule; V7A gate remains FAIL, no claim it authorized continuation
rationale: User requested continuation if recent labels help. Exposed expanding-history control improved all six primary T2 sessions; use this as a new development hypothesis, not fresh evidence.
fresh_selection: acquisition-plan.json: fixed ranks19..21 in eight known people; no substitution

fit.labels: retain all previously purchased labels; no decay or forgetting

output_during_probes_and_delay: zero; all bins remain in the shared score

trigger.features: causal combined representation standardized and clipped using frozen first30 normalizer
trigger.score: mean over features of KL(N(current_mean,current_variance)||N(reference_mean,reference_variance)); diagonal Gaussian with floored variances
trigger.force_probe: remaining_slots equals remaining_probe_budget OR candidate_start minus last_probe_end >=180 seconds
trigger.purpose: allocate fixed feedback budget in time; not a proof of decoding failure

selection.unit: exclude entire target participant from development ranking
selection.objective: highest equal-participant mean full-interval R2 of triggered240
selection.evidence: exposed source selection only; T2-informed design is not untouched-person development

evaluation.common_mask: valid-go rows excluding62-bin acquisition burn, truncated at observed end; >=50 rows required
evaluation.session_score: R2 from pooled common bins, plus summedMSE and angular error
evaluation.harmful_time: fraction of valid rows in diagnostic windows whose summedMSE exceeds zero
evaluation.interruption_time: observed probe and update-delay bins within shared deployment interval, independent of valid-go mask
evaluation.label_cost: planned maximum and actual unique observed purchased seconds both reported, including non-go labels and short cases
evaluation.short_or_missing: retain without replacement and with explicit unavailable scores
evaluation.diagnostic_only: scorer may describe pre-probe errors and recovery; no scorer metrics enter requests or selection on fresh data

fresh_success_gates.periodic_T2_recovery: all3requested sessions scorable, meanR2>=.05, >=2positive, meanpairedgainoverfrozen120>=.05 and paired95%lower>0
fresh_success_gates.triggered_timing_value: same actual labelbudget asperiodic in every complete600ssession, meanpairedcohortgainoverperiodic>=.01 and paired95%lower>0, T2mean no worse thanperiodic
fresh_success_gates.risk: report all harmful sessions/windows and interruptions regardless of gates; no safety certification

limits: offline recorded tasks, no closed-loop behavior change simulation
no acquisition or upstream feature causality claim
real fitting time measured separately; two-second allowance is an evaluation assumption
conditional continuation was changed after exposed V7A outcomes and before any V7B fresh outcomes
